annotations.title: S&P 500 scorecard: what followed past readings in this regime

description: What has the S&P 500 done after past readings in this regime? Returns the scorecard row for the regime of the last settled close, as regimecard.com publishes it on its history page: the S&P 500's typical return and how often it rose in the 5 and 20 trading days after past readings in that regime, and a bad outcome as a downside measure. Any of the five regimes can be asked for by key. $0.01 per call in USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana (x402). Updated after each US close. The row follows the last settled close, whose date is asOf. Useful when an agent needs base rates for the S&P 500 in the current market regime.

inputSchema.description: Query parameters, all optional. Any other value is a free 400.

regime.description: One of the five regimes, by its key. Without it, the regime of the last settled close.
